description: Searches the current job listings on Christian Tech Jobs by keyword, category, remote and location, and returns each job with a link to its page on Christian Tech Jobs.

category.description: One category name from list_categories, matched case-insensitively, and known aliases work too. Any other name, or more than one category, returns an error instead of wider results. Without a category, the search covers every category.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, from 1 to 20. The default is 10.

location.description: A city, state or country to look for in each job's location, matched case-insensitively. Remote jobs have Remote as their location, so the remote argument is the better way to find them.

offset.description: How many matching jobs to skip before the results start, for paging. The default is 0, and the response's total says how many jobs matched.

query.description: A word or short phrase to look for in each job's title, company, skills and categories. Matching is case-insensitive and the whole phrase has to appear inside the title, the company, one skill or one category, so one or two words work best.

remote.description: With true only remote jobs come back, and with false only jobs that aren't remote. Without it, both come back. A job counts as remote when its location is Remote.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs on Christian Tech Jobs
